name: div_weather_structure_int_balanced
rationale: Balances the strongest weather and structure p50 runs with low-spike and low-direction-error specialists.

name: wide_q_low_spike_weather_struct
rationale: Adds a weather-diverse quantile member and low-spike nowcast/outage runs while slightly widening intervals.

name: direction_heavy_low_dir_brier
rationale: Leans into the best direction-Brier members while keeping the top weather run dominant for p50.

name: spike_shrink_exploration
rationale: Explores stronger spike shrinkage and wider quantiles, using the lowest spike-Brier runs as anchors.

name: max_diverse_weather_int_spike_mix
rationale: Maximally diversifies across weather, structure, INT, LGB, nowcast and outage families with mild calibration.

name: refine_int4_p50_fresh_spike_div_dir
rationale: Refines the best recipe by swapping INT4 into p50 for MAE and fresh outage nowcast into spike for lower spike Brier while keeping the diverse direction blend.

name: spike_fresh_high_dir_temp_low
rationale: Increases the lowest-spike-Brier outage run and adds a small direction-boost allocation to improve spike and direction metrics without sacrificing the weather-led p50.

name: wide_q_width_spike_shrink_explore
rationale: Explores a slightly wider quantile calibration and stronger spike shrinkage with a heavier weather p50, aiming to reduce pinball and spike losses simultaneously.

name: balanced_int4_w3_q_tight_short
rationale: Balances INT4 and W3 in p50, tightens short quantiles, and mixes fresh outage plus nowcast spike members to improve calibration robustly.

name: weather_w1_q_diversity_fresh_spike
rationale: Adds weather W1 as a diverse quantile member and raises fresh outage weighting in spike, testing whether extra weather diversity improves pinball and spike Brier.

name: w3_p50_boost_tight_short_q
rationale: Boost W3 in p50 for better MAE while tightening q_width_short to 1.0 to reduce pinball on short-step forecasts.

name: int4_focus_positive_shift
rationale: Leverage INT4's low MAE with higher p50 weight and slight positive shift, keeping q moderately tight for pinball gains.

name: bands_spike_diversity_low_temp
rationale: Add S_mixture_gap_G_bands to both q and spike for structural diversity, slightly lowering spike_temp to sharpen spike calibration.

name: w2_rt_err_q_wide_exploration
rationale: Inject W2_ifs_rev_+_rt_err into q for fresh weather-rt diversity, widening q_width to 1.09 to absorb the added variance.

name: dir_boost_high_temp_tight_q_low_spike
rationale: Add dir_boost with higher dir_temp 1.1 to sharpen direction Brier, tightening q_width to 1.03 and reducing spike_shrink for cleaner spike signal.

name: core_diverse_stack
rationale: Refinement: per-group diverse stacks (weather+INT+structure for p50/q, outages+nowcast+structure for spike, INT+lgb+Kimi for dir) with mild widening and spike shrinkage.

name: spike_leverage_stack
rationale: Refinement: push the highest-leverage spike Brier gain by stacking the four best spike families with softening/shrinkage while keeping the strongest p50 and q cores.

name: dir_sharpen_explore
rationale: Exploration: sharpen (dir_temp<1) the blended direction probabilities since averaging diverse families softens them, on top of strong spike and p50 cores.

name: wide_shortq_explore
rationale: Exploration: widen the averaged quantiles (especially steps 1-8) to cover August spikes, adding IFS-rev weather diversity in the q group.

name: all_diverse_trio
rationale: Exploration: minimal 3-family 'all' blend (weather/structure/outages) to test whether one diverse mix plus calibration rivals the per-group stacks.

name: refine_best_p50_int4_025
rationale: Raise INT4 in the p50 blend to improve MAE while preserving the best quantile, spike, and direction members.

name: p50_lgb_boost_best_q_spike
rationale: Shift p50 weight from W3 to the stronger LGB run while keeping the proven best quantile and spike recipes.

name: q_w1_diversity_balanced
rationale: Increase weather W1 quantile diversity while retaining the best p50, spike, and direction blends.

name: spike_nowcast_boost
rationale: Overweight the nowcast spike component and shrink slightly to target a lower spike Brier score.

name: dir_temp_090_int4_p50
rationale: Combine the INT4 p50 MAE gain with a lower direction temperature to improve direction Brier.

name: dir_sharpen_mae_boost
rationale: Keep dir_sharpen_explore's winning dir/q/spike exactly, but swap in the lower-MAE p50 mix (adds LGB + W3) that repeatedly hit ~27.06.

name: dir_sharpen_spike_leverage
rationale: Marry the best direction blend (temp 0.85) with spike_leverage_stack's 4-member spike that also reached 0.0693 Brier, plus slightly heavier W6 in p50/q.

name: ultra_sharp_dir_explore
rationale: Explores whether pushing dir_temp below 0.85 sharpens the already-best 0.4258 direction Brier further while leaving the strong p50/q/spike core untouched.

name: int4_heavy_p50_sharpen
rationale: INT4 has the best single-run MAE (27.42), so this tests a heavier INT4 p50 weight to push blended MAE under 27.05 while keeping the proven dir/q and a diversified spike.

name: fresh_spike_diverse_dir
rationale: Exploration: widen spike diversity to five members (adding outages_fresh and rt198+wind+cons, the best-Brier spike runs) and add INT5 to the direction mix for extra decorrelation.
